title: DBFlux redesign: Completion menu kinds and colors (#1013) · light
brief: Issue #1013, the five approved points: kind word per SQL suggestion including cte, syntax color per completion kind across editors with a plain fallback, menu width counting the kind word and following the interface font size; match highlight unchanged.

artboards.title: SQL kinds and colors, CTE, other editors, larger font
artboards.tradeoff: A right-aligned word costs width but needs no learning, unlike TBL/SCH badges; colors repeat the editor's own token colors, so a table and its match highlight can still look alike until the editor styling lands.
